title: code.* namespace has no file enumeration; cells bootstrap via tools.glob
wanted_capability: Cross-file fact composition in the code namespace: (a) code.files({ dir?, language? }) enumeration so fact pipelines are self-contained (original ask), and (b) multi-file fact calls — code.items accepting files: string[] (or a glob) and/or a cross-file symbol search — so "find symbol X in the crate" is one call. Recurrence pattern across four probes: probe-code-facts-1/3 and probe-lsp-1/2 all iterated files in sequential for-loops (the batching recipe notwithstanding), probe-lsp-1 hallucinated a bare content_search global, and probe-lsp-2 burned a turn guessing the wrong file before iterating. Single-file facts are sound; the per-crate fan-out is the recurring manual step.
fallback_used: tools.glob({ pattern: "src/**/*.rs" }) in the first cell.
notes: Bumped low→medium 2026-06-12 after the lsp probes: now the top recurring polish ask. Evidence sessions: probe-code-facts-1/3, probe-edits-1/2, probe-lsp-1/2 in BRO_HOME=/tmp/refactor-v2-probe/brohome.
